title: The Pinata Endurance Challenge
description: The Pinata Endurance Challenge — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Excited Lad

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Destroy the 4 Pinatas in the Pinata Endurance Challenge off of Level 4 of Ratsputin's Gulag and return to the Excited Lad in Ratstpuin's Holding Cell.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Excited Lad

Repeatable: No

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Destroy the 4 Pinatas in the Pinata Endurance Challenge off of Level 4 of Ratsputin's Gulag and return to the Excited Lad in Ratstpuin's Holding Cell.

Offer:

The Endurance Challenge is not something to kid about, Dungeon Runner. I hope you have been doing some jumping jacks or deep knee bends because the Endurance Challenge really, and I mean really, challenges your endurance! You are going to have to fight four groups of mobs just to get to the Pinata, so take your time with each fight.

Head out to the entrance to the Pinata Invitational off of Level 4 of Ratsputin's Gulag. When you get there you will need to destroy the four Pinatas. Return to me, the Excited Lad, here in Ratsputin's Holding Cell when you are done.

Turn-in:

Awesome! You were all like bam, zip, swoosh, whack, aimbot, exploit, and then finishing move!

Objectives:

  • Destroy Pinatas

Level range: 75–100
